import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK))
import numpy as np, json
from lib7 import *
allids=[r['id'] for r in practice()]; y=labels_for(allids, practice, LABELS); Y=np.eye(8)[y]
f=np.load('feats_drop46.npz'); M,C,M0=f['M'],f['C'],f['M0']
cp=np.load('carry_prov.npz'); wlin=cp['wlin']; wraw=cp['wraw']; mu0=cp['mu0']
tr=np.ones(1496,bool)
def jointfit(M,C,M0,c=10,lam=.05,c0=.5,na=1008):
    mu=M.mean(0); Z=pool_z(M,C,c,mu); Wf=anchor_dirs(Z); Kc=gelu(Z@Wf.T); Kc=.5*(Kc+Kc.T)
    piv=pivchol(Kc,na); Wd=Wf[piv]; Kaa=Kc[np.ix_(piv,piv)]; Phi=feats(Z,Wd); Lin=lin_feats(M0,tr)
    coef,b=fit(Phi,Lin,Y,Kaa,lam,c0); return coef,b,Phi,Lin,piv,Z
coef,b,Phi,Lin,piv,Z=jointfit(M,C,M0)
Wn=coef[1008:]; 
Sl=Lin@Wn; So=Lin@wlin
B,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(np.c_[So,np.ones(1496)],Sl,rcond=None)
res=Sl-np.c_[So,np.ones(1496)]@B
print('R2 new lin scores from old carry span', 1-(res**2).sum()/((Sl-Sl.mean(0))**2).sum())
print('norm of lin part vs kernel part', np.std(Sl), np.std(Phi@coef[:1008]))
S=np.c_[Phi,Lin]@coef+b; print('train acc joint', (S.argmax(1)==y).mean())
# how was wlin made? compare to joint fit on old seq1024 / base features
fo=np.load('feats_seq1024_depth.npz'); 
coef2,_,_,_,_,_=jointfit(fo['M9'].astype(np.float64),fo['C9'].astype(np.float64),M0)
S2=Lin@coef2[1008:]; B2,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(np.c_[So,np.ones(1496)],S2,rcond=None)
r2=S2-np.c_[So,np.ones(1496)]@B2; print('R2 seq1024 joint lin from carry span',1-(r2**2).sum()/((S2-S2.mean(0))**2).sum())
print('wlin vs coef2 lin corr', np.corrcoef(wlin.ravel(), coef2[1008:].ravel())[0,1], 'vs Wn', np.corrcoef(wlin.ravel(), Wn.ravel())[0,1])
